investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 21(4A) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.provides that this offence shall not apply in relation to goods brought in the aircraft from a place outside the customs territory of the European Union.
(ii) Section 21(5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.provides that nothing in section 21(4) shall prohibit the the departure of passengers or crew from the vicinity of an aircraft or the removal of goods from an aircraft where that departure / removal is necessary for reasons of health, safety or the preservation of life or property.
